name: vibrate
title: Vibrate
guard: refused while the battery is low
effects: felt by the accelerometer; costs a little charge

name: speak
title: Speak
description: Says one of a few sounds through text to speech. Never words it understands: only sounds it can choose.
guard: refused while the body is hot

name: light
title: Light colour
use_case: A room with a smart bulb
description: Sets a smart bulb's colour for a while.
guard: refused at night if someone sleeps
effects: seen by the camera; the room's light changes

name: move
title: Move
use_case: A robot or a motorised camera
description: Turns a motor a little left or right, or stops it.

target.detail: a small turn of a wheel or a camera mount

guard: refused when the motor is hot or blocked
effects: the picture moves; the accelerometer feels it; costs charge

name: notify
title: Notify
use_case: A companion on a phone or desktop
description: Shows a short notification to the person.

target.detail: a notice with one of a few fixed texts

guard: refused more than once in ten minutes
effects: the person may answer: touch, sound

name: thermostat
title: Thermostat
description: Asks the heating to go a little warmer or cooler.

target.detail: the target temperature, by half a degree

name: plug
title: Smart plug
description: Switches a smart plug on or off (a fan, a lamp, a radio).
guard: refused more often than once a minute
effects: whatever is plugged in starts or stops

name: sound-clip
title: Sound clip
description: Plays one of a few short recorded sounds.

name: post
title: Post a message
description: Posts one of a few fixed signs into a chat channel.

target.detail: a fixed sign, never free text

guard: refused more than once an hour
effects: others may answer in the channel

name: blank
title: Blank
description: Start from nothing: say what it does, where it acts and what it may choose among.
